children: China property developer's interim revenue dropped 49%, marking a sharp decline from last year
Net profit attributable to owners turned positive, reversing a loss in prior period
Company says improved results driven by effective cost and expense control
Company did not provide specific financial outlook
COST CONTROL - Co said improved profit performance was due to effective management of costs and control of expenses
PROPERTY DELIVERY DECLINE – Revenue fell 49.4% to RMB1.15 bln, primarily due to lower property-sales area delivered
ONSHORE DEBT RESTRUCTURING – Profit turnaround was primarily driven by partial completion of the onshore debt restructuring, generating an RMB7.8 bln gain
